summary: Restrict access to discount/credits-sensitive Unit Economics dashboard views + enable audit logging
related_confluence_pages: Access control policy for unit economics dashboard (Finance/Product restricted views)
description:
Requester: Naomi Feldman (Access control requirements)

Context
The internal Unit Economics dashboard includes views/slices that expose discount and credits impact (net vs gross cost) and pricing-sensitive breakdowns. Finance leadership requested these views be restricted to a small set of roles (Finance leadership, FP&A owners, select Product leadership). Engineering and broader org should still be able to access operational unit-cost views that exclude discount/credits attribution.

Request
1) Add role-based gating for discount/credits-sensitive fields and views in the Unit Economics dashboard.
2) Ensure the access is auditable: log view access events (who, when, what slice) and retain logs per compliance guidance.
3) Ensure restricted content cannot be accessed via direct API calls (not just hidden in UI).

What is considered restricted
- Any chart/table showing net cost after discounts/credits
- Any breakdown that attributes blended $/1M output tokens deltas to discounts/credits policy
- Any export (CSV) that includes discount_rate / credits_applied / net_revenue_adj (or equivalent)

Non-restricted (remain broadly available)
- Blended cost $/1M output tokens excluding discounts/credits (compute + overhead allocation)
- Operational drivers: model mix, region mix, cache hit-rate impact, quantization_profile / runtime_config slices (provided they do not include pricing/discount columns)

Proposed access model (initial)
- Add a new permission: unit_econ.view_discount_sensitive
- Map permission to SSO groups:
  - finance-leadership
  - fpa
  - product-leadership (limited)
- Default behavior: if user lacks permission, dashboard should:
  - Hide restricted toggles (e.g., Gross/Net switch)
  - Return 403 for restricted endpoints/fields
  - Redact restricted fields in any multi-purpose endpoint payloads

Audit requirements
- Log at minimum: user_id, email, role/group, timestamp, endpoint/action, filter context (model/region/tier), and whether export was triggered
- Logs must be searchable by Security/Compliance and retained >= 90 days (confirm with Security)

Acceptance criteria
- Users without permission cannot see or export restricted views; direct API access returns 403
- Users with permission can see the net/discount-sensitive views with no regression
- Audit logs show access events for restricted actions and can be correlated to a user
- Confirmed by Finance (Laura Bennett / Rishi Malhotra) and Security reviewer (Marcus Lin) before enabling for the broader org

Notes
This is an internal helpdesk request; implementation work is tracked in the Unit Econ dashboard project. If needed, we can ship UI gating first but must not ship without backend enforcement for restricted fields/endpoints.
comments: 2025-02-06 10:12 Naomi Feldman (Reporter): Finance is asking that we lock down anything that reveals discount/credit impact. The dashboard is already being referenced in weekly reviews, and we don’t want broad visibility into discount policy. Can we prioritize before the internal rollout widens beyond Finance + PM leads?

2025-02-06 11:03 Marcus Lin (Assignee): Acknowledged. We’ll require backend enforcement (403) for restricted endpoints and add audit logs. I’ll sync with Chloe/Felix on where the Console API serves these fields and whether the semantic layer includes discount columns by default.

2025-02-07 14:26 Chloe Martin: Console backend currently has a single endpoint that can optionally include discount fields for Finance debug. We can split into /unit-econ/summary (non-sensitive) and /unit-econ/finance (sensitive) or enforce field-level redaction based on permission. Preference: split to reduce accidental exposure in future features.

2025-02-08 09:40 Rishi Malhotra: Confirming the restricted set should include anything that shows credits/discounts and any exports that would allow reverse-engineering pricing. OK if engineering can still see compute+overhead blended cost (gross), and driver attribution that’s purely operational.

2025-02-10 16:05 Marcus Lin: Security requirement: audit log entries must include filter context and must record export actions separately. Also ensure the permission check happens server-side and is covered by tests.

2025-02-14 13:18 Marcus Lin: Implementation underway in redwood/pr-11905. Adds permission unit_econ.view_discount_sensitive, server-side gating, and audit logging for restricted endpoints + exports. Will stage behind internal feature flag and validate with Finance.

2025-02-18 15:02 Laura Bennett: Reviewed in staging with Rishi. Finance users can access Net views; non-finance users only see Gross/operational. Export for Net is blocked for non-finance (403). Please proceed with prod rollout after Security sign-off.

2025-02-20 10:27 Marcus Lin: Rolled to prod. Verified 403s for non-permitted accounts, verified audit logs are emitted and searchable. Closing INT-2210; follow-ups tracked in the Unit Econ project for ongoing access reviews.
resolution: Implemented role-based access control for discount/credits-sensitive unit economics views and exports, enforced server-side with 403 responses for unauthorized users, and added audit logging for restricted access actions. Validated by Finance stakeholders and Security reviewer; rolled out to prod behind internal feature flag.
